family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Light Duty Commercial

spec.description:
Bradford Enviroseal ProctorWrap Commercial Wall (CW) is a
premium, Light Duty vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered specifically for
commercial timber and steel-framed wall construction. Composed of a spunbond
polyolefin non-woven textile, it provides a high water-vapour transmission rate
that allows moisture vapour from inside the building to escape, while preventing
wind-driven rain and air infiltration from penetrating into the wall cavity.
With higher material weight and tensile strength than standard residential
wraps, it is certified for use with commercial claddings, brick, steel,
fibre-cement, and Hebel systems.
features:
Engineered specifically for
multi-storey commercial and residential projects

Highly vapour permeable
(Class 4) allowing internal moisture to escape and preventing mould

Functions
as a water barrier, shielding insulation and structural framing from driving
rain

Effective air barrier reducing convective air leakage and improving HVAC
energy efficiency

Robust non-woven spunbond polyolefin construction resists
tearing during installation

Printed with a 150mm lap line for simple,
compliant overlap alignment

Suitable for timber and steel frame constructions
including Hebel facade systems

Rated for wind regions A and B for high-rise
commercial wall applications

Non-reflective face reduces glare on site during
installation

technical.value: 1500 mm width x 50 m length (75 m² per roll)

Machine Direction
> 160 N, Lateral Direction > 140 N

spec.fire:
Flammability Index ≤ 5 to AS 1530.2; Suitable for
external walls in BAL 12.5 to BAL-40 bushfire zones under AS 3959
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4200.1:2017, AS/NZS 4200.2, AS 1530.2, NCC 2022 Volume 1
& 2 condensation management provisions
spec.sustainability:
Zero ODP,
non-hazardous, 100% recyclable polyolefin materials, low VOC
install:
Fix
Enviroseal CW to the outside of the commercial timber or steel wall frame with
printed face outward

Fasten with broad-headed fasteners at maximum 300mm
centres to studs and plates

Run sheets horizontally, starting from bottom
plate and working upward

Ensure upper sheets overlap lower sheets by at
least 150mm along the printed lap guide

Tape all horizontal and vertical
overlaps with Enviroseal HighTack Tape or specify CW-IT

Ensure membrane is
separated from exterior cladding by a drained cavity

Seal around windows,
door frames, and penetrations to complete the continuous weather barrier
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall construction is steel or timber frame
commercial/residential building

Verify requirement for Class 4
vapour-permeable membrane to mitigate condensation

Calculate roll count based
on 75m² per roll allowing 150mm overlaps

Select standard CW or CW-IT (with
integrated tape) for faster installation

Ensure cladding will be installed
within 60 days of wrap exposure
limitations:
Not suitable for roofing applications (Light Duty
rating does not meet DtS roof traffic requirements)

Do not leave exposed to
direct UV sunlight for longer than 60 days

Not for open-joint rainscreens
where >30% is exposed (use Black Label)

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Wall
Wraps - Light Duty Commercial (Enviroseal ProctorWrap Commercial Wall / CW,
product code 114175) is a high-strength, Light Duty Class 4 vapour-permeable
wall wrap engineered for commercial and multi-residential timber and steel stud
construction. Fabricated from a spunbond polyolefin non-woven composite, it
provides superior water hold-out and airtightness while allowing internal water
vapour to escape, preventing rot and mould in building assemblies. Suitable for
wind regions A and B and compliant with AS/NZS 4200.1 and AS 1530.2
(Flammability Index ≤ 5), it delivers heavy-duty tear resistance for commercial
jobsites.
